services.name: Captree Fishing
services.desc: Patty Ann Charters offers fishing trips from Captree State Park, New York. The crew are professional guides, who have won many tournaments throughout their career. Captain Greg Gargiulo has been the New York State and IGFA Record Holder twice, so if you are looking for a trip of a lifetime - you found the right boat and the right captain! A trip with Patty Ann Charters comes inclusive with gear and tackle, as well as the licenses and fish cleaning. Don’t hesitate to bring drinks and food onboard.
